name: Temperature Above Normal Conditions
description: System temperature exceeds the expected normal operating range; typically indicates heating control issues or reduced cooling effectiveness.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","signal":"temperature","threshold":"above_normal","note":"Intermediate (derived from child events)."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Temperature Above Normal Conditions occurs if any one of the child causes occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"temp_above_normal_conditions"}

name: Cooling Reservoir Blocked
description: Cooling reservoir circulation is restricted or blocked, reducing heat removal and increasing system temperature.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"cooling_reservoir","failure":"blockage","note":"Intermediate (derived from leaf events)."}

name: Cooling Reservoir Leakage
description: Loss of coolant/volume from the cooling reservoir due to leakage, reducing cooling capacity.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"cooling_reservoir","failure":"leakage","detection_hint":"Monitor level/visual inspection; correlate with temperature rise."}

name: Recirculation of Alternate Route
description: Unintended recirculation through an alternate route (e.g., via both bucket paths), potentially increasing temperature due to poor heat rejection or mixing.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"routing","note":"Intermediate driven by simultaneous bucket leaks (AND)."}

name: Heater Kept On
description: Heater remains on when it should be off (control fault or operator oversight), elevating system temperature.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"heater","failure":"stuck_on","detection_hint":"Compare heater state vs setpoint; confirm relay/control signal."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Cooling Reservoir Blocked occurs if any one of the child blockage contributors occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"cooling_reservoir_blocked"}

name: Valves Close
description: Valve(s) are closed or partially closed, restricting flow and reducing cooling circulation.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","component":"valve","failure":"closed","detection_hint":"Check valve position indicators; correlate with flow drop."}

name: Contamination
description: Debris/particles in the circuit cause restriction or fouling, reducing cooling effectiveness and potentially blocking passages.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","failure":"contamination","detection_hint":"Hard to detect directly; infer from recurring restrictions / inspection."}

name: AND Gate
description: AND logic: Recirculation of Alternate Route occurs only when all required conditions occur together (both bucket leaks).
metadata: {"gate":"AND","parent":"recirculation_of_alternate_route"}

name: Bucket 1 leak
description: Leak in bucket 1 path causes unintended flow behavior or reduced system stability (level drop / air ingress).
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"bucket_1","failure":"leak","detection_hint":"Visual inspection; level trend; correlate with flow instability."}

name: Bucket 2 leak
description: Leak in bucket 2 path causes unintended flow behavior or reduced system stability (level drop / air ingress).
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"bucket_2","failure":"leak","detection_hint":"Visual inspection; level trend; correlate with flow instability."}

name: Temperature Under Normal Conditions
description: System temperature falls below the defined normal operating range; typically indicates excessive cooling or insufficient heating.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","signal":"temperature","threshold":"under_normal","note":"Intermediate (derived from child events)."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Temperature Under Normal Conditions occurs if any one of the child causes occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"temp_under_normal_conditions"}

name: Excessive Cooling Duration
description: Cooling is applied for longer than designed/required, resulting in temperature dropping below normal range.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"cooling","failure":"excessive_duration","note":"Intermediate driven by operator error or hot reservoir leakage."}

name: Heater kept off
description: Heater is not enabled when heating is needed (e.g., control decision or operator action), allowing temperature to fall below normal.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"heater","failure":"kept_off","note":"Intermediate driven by operator error or heater malfunction."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Excessive Cooling Duration occurs if operator error happens or if hot reservoir leakage contributes to prolonged/ineffective thermal control.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"excessive_cooling_duration"}

name: Operator Error
description: Incorrect human action (wrong setting, delayed response, or incorrect valve/heater/cooling operation) leading to undesired temperature behavior.
metadata: {"domain":"human_factor","failure":"operator_error","detection_hint":"Validate procedures, logging, and operator actions vs expected sequence.","note":"Shared leaf used in multiple branches."}

name: Leakage in Hot Reservoir
description: Leak in the hot reservoir reduces heating capacity/available hot fluid, contributing to lower system temperature.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"hot_reservoir","failure":"leakage","detection_hint":"Monitor level/visual inspection; correlate with inability to maintain temperature."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Heater kept off occurs due to operator error or heater malfunction preventing heating.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"heater_kept_off"}

name: Heater Malfunction
description: Heater fails to operate correctly (no heat output, control fault, relay failure), resulting in insufficient heating and low temperature.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"heater","failure":"malfunction","detection_hint":"Compare heater command vs measured temperature response; check power/relay state."}

name: High Flow
description: Flow rate exceeds the defined normal operating range; may indicate pump overspeed/overdrive or abnormal restrictions/routing effects that force high flow in the measured segment.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","signal":"flow","threshold":"above_normal","note":"Intermediate (derived from child events)."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: High Flow occurs if any one of the child causes occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"high_flow"}

name: Pump Operating Above Normal Conditions
description: Pump operates above its intended setting (speed/command), increasing delivered flow beyond normal.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"pump","failure":"over_operation","note":"Intermediate driven by operator error or control/system error."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Pump Operating Above Normal Conditions occurs due to operator error or system/control error.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"pump_operating_above_normal_conditions"}

name: System Error
description: Control/software/hardware fault causes an incorrect pump command (e.g., wrong setpoint, bad feedback loop, or controller bug) leading to over-operation.
metadata: {"domain":"control_system","component":"controller","failure":"system_error","detection_hint":"Compare commanded vs expected pump state; review logs/alerts."}

name: Blockage Before GP
description: Restriction/blockage upstream of GP (gauge point) alters flow distribution and can contribute to abnormal measured flow conditions.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","location":"before_gp","failure":"blockage","note":"Intermediate; diagram shows AND junction at this level."}

name: AND Gate
description: AND logic: Blockage Before GP requires combined conditions per the diagram (both route-related blockage contributors must be present).
metadata: {"gate":"AND","parent":"blockage_before_gp","note":"Use dome-shaped gate in diagram."}

name: Blockage in original route
description: Restriction in the primary/original flow path (e.g., closed valve or contamination) reduces or redirects flow.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","routing":"original_route","failure":"blockage","note":"Intermediate (driven by valves close and/or contamination)."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Blockage in original route occurs if valves are closed or contamination causes restriction.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"blockage_in_original_route"}

name: Blockage in Alternative Route
description: Restriction in the alternative route reduces bypass/redirected flow capability; may cause abnormal distribution and contribute to high measured flow elsewhere.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","routing":"alternative_route","failure":"blockage","note":"Intermediate (driven by operator error / valves close / contamination in your diagram)."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Blockage in Alternative Route occurs if operator error happens, valves close, or contamination causes restriction.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"blockage_in_alternative_route"}

name: Blockage After GP
description: Restriction downstream of GP changes flow/pressure characteristics and may lead to abnormal flow readings or rerouting effects.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","location":"after_gp","failure":"blockage","note":"Intermediate; includes contamination and a valve-closure AND junction."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Blockage After GP occurs due to contamination or due to the combined valve-closure condition (AND gate branch).
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"blockage_after_gp"}

name: AND Gate
description: AND logic: downstream valve-related blockage condition requires all listed valves to be closed (per diagram).
metadata: {"gate":"AND","parent":"blockage_after_gp","branch":"valves","note":"Use dome-shaped gate in diagram."}

name: Valve 1 closed
description: Valve 1 is closed or significantly restricted, contributing to downstream blockage and altered flow conditions.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","component":"valve","valve":1,"failure":"closed","detection_hint":"Check valve position/indicator; correlate with flow/pressure change."}

name: Valve 2 closed
description: Valve 2 is closed or significantly restricted, contributing to downstream blockage and altered flow conditions.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","component":"valve","valve":2,"failure":"closed","detection_hint":"Check valve position/indicator; correlate with flow/pressure change."}

name: Valve 3 closed
description: Valve 3 is closed or significantly restricted, contributing to downstream blockage and altered flow conditions.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","component":"valve","valve":3,"failure":"closed","detection_hint":"Check valve position/indicator; correlate with flow/pressure change."}

name: Leaks
description: Unintended fluid loss from the system due to cracks, loose fittings, or seal failures; can reduce performance and cause instability.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","failure":"leakage","note":"Intermediate (derived from child leak sources)."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Leaks occur if any one of the listed leak sources occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"leaks"}

name: Pipe Crack
description: Crack in a pipe/line causes leakage and possible air ingress, reducing effective flow and system stability.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","component":"pipe","failure":"crack","detection_hint":"Visual inspection; wet spots; pressure decay; recurring air bubbles."}

name: Loose Fittings
description: Loose couplings/fittings allow leakage at joints, especially under pressure or vibration.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","component":"fitting","failure":"loose_connection","detection_hint":"Visual inspection; tightening check; leak around joints."}

name: Broken pump
description: Pump fails to deliver expected performance due to mechanical, electrical, fluid compatibility, or seal issues.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"pump","failure":"pump_failure","note":"Intermediate: can be driven by wrong fluid, electrical issues, seal leak, contamination, cavitation, or unknown malfunction."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Broken pump occurs if any one of the listed contributing faults occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"broken_pump"}

name: Wrong fluid
description: Incorrect fluid type/mixture (viscosity, contamination, or incompatible chemistry) causes poor pump operation or damage.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"pump","failure":"wrong_fluid","detection_hint":"Hard to detect immediately; validate fluid spec; observe abnormal noise/temperature/flow."}

name: Electrical Problems
description: Electrical supply/control issues prevent the pump from running reliably or at correct power.
metadata: {"domain":"electrical","subsystem":"pump","failure":"electrical_issue","note":"Intermediate driven by operator error or power outage (per your diagram)."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Electrical Problems occur due to operator error (miswiring/incorrect setup) or power outage.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"electrical_problems"}

name: Power Outage
description: Loss of electrical power prevents pump operation and may cause abrupt flow drop or unstable behavior on restart.
metadata: {"domain":"electrical","component":"power_supply","failure":"outage","detection_hint":"Power indicator off; controller reset; logs show loss-of-power event."}

name: pump seal leak
description: Seal failure at the pump shaft/connection causes leakage and may allow air ingress, reducing pump efficiency or causing damage.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","component":"pump_seal","failure":"seal_leak","detection_hint":"Leak near pump; wet housing; reduced performance; possible cavitation-like symptoms."}

name: unknown malfunction
description: Unidentified fault causing abnormal pump behavior when no specific failure mode is confirmed.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"pump","failure":"unknown","detection_hint":"Use as placeholder until root-cause is confirmed; log symptoms and diagnostics."}

name: Cavatation
description: Cavitation occurs when local pressure drops below vapor pressure, causing vapor bubbles and potential pump damage, noise, and reduced flow.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"pump","failure":"cavitation","note":"Intermediate driven by operator error, blockage before pump, bucket leaks, or alternate-route circulation above designed time."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Cavitation occurs if any one of the listed contributing conditions occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"cavitation"}

children.name: Alternative Route Circulation Above Designed Time

name: Blockage Before pump
description: Restriction on the suction side of the pump reduces inlet pressure, increasing the likelihood of cavitation.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","location":"before_pump","failure":"blockage","note":"Intermediate suction-side restriction condition."}

name: Bucket leaks
description: Leakage from one or both buckets reduces available volume and can introduce air, contributing to cavitation and unstable pump inlet conditions.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"buckets","failure":"leakage","note":"Intermediate bucket leakage condition (children are Bucket 1 leak + Bucket 2 leak elsewhere)."}

name: Alternative Route Circulation Above Designed Time
description: Fluid circulates through an alternate route for longer than designed, potentially reducing inlet pressure and contributing to cavitation.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"routing","failure":"alt_route_over_duration","note":"Intermediate driven by a required combination (AND) of bucket leak conditions (per diagram)."}

name: AND Gate
description: AND logic: Alternative Route Circulation Above Designed Time occurs only when all required input conditions occur together (per diagram).
metadata: {"gate":"AND","parent":"alt_route_circulation_above_designed_time","note":"Use dome-shaped gate in diagram."}

name: Pump under-performing
description: Pump delivers lower-than-expected flow/pressure compared to its normal operating range; can be caused by mechanical wear, cavitation, incorrect settings, or electrical/supply issues.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","subsystem":"pump","failure":"under_performance","note":"Intermediate node (root cause depends on linked children in the tree)."}

name: Sensor Malfunction
description: Sensor provides unreliable or incorrect readings (drift, spikes, dropouts, or stuck values) due to electrical, environmental, or controller issues.
metadata: {"domain":"instrumentation","subsystem":"sensors","failure":"malfunction","note":"Intermediate: may involve Arduino/controller, water contact, wiring, or overload."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Sensor Malfunction occurs if any one of the listed sensor/controller issues occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"sensor_malfunction"}

name: Arduino
description: Controller/Arduino subsystem issues affect sensor reading acquisition, processing, or transmission (software, power, or hardware constraints).
metadata: {"domain":"control_system","component":"arduino","failure":"controller_issue","note":"Intermediate: driven by code issues, storage limits, power issues, or unknown malfunction."}

name: Water Contact
description: Water/moisture contacts sensor wires or electronics, causing short circuits, corrosion, or unstable readings.
metadata: {"domain":"instrumentation","failure":"water_contact","detection_hint":"Visual inspection for moisture; sudden noisy readings; intermittent shorts."}

name: Wire Misplacement
description: Incorrect wiring (wrong pin, swapped polarity, loose connection) results in incorrect or missing sensor readings.
metadata: {"domain":"instrumentation","failure":"wiring_error","detection_hint":"Continuity check; verify pin mapping; compare expected vs observed readings."}

name: Sensor Overload
description: Sensor operates beyond its rated range (e.g., too high temperature/pressure/flow), causing saturation, clipping, or damage leading to inaccurate readings.
metadata: {"domain":"instrumentation","failure":"overload","detection_hint":"Readings stuck at max/min; sudden step changes; compare with secondary measurement if available."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Arduino issues occur if any one of the listed controller-related problems occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"arduino"}

name: Code issues
description: Software/firmware problems in the Arduino program cause incorrect sensor handling, parsing, scaling, or reporting.
metadata: {"domain":"software","component":"arduino_firmware","failure":"code_issue","note":"Intermediate: driven by error in code or wrong program uploaded."}

name: Full storage
description: Arduino storage/memory/logging space is full, causing logging failures, buffer overflow, or dropped sensor updates.
metadata: {"domain":"embedded","component":"storage","failure":"storage_full","detection_hint":"Logs stop updating; write errors; device resets or freezes."}

name: No Power
description: Arduino/sensor subsystem has no power supply, preventing sensor readings from being produced.
metadata: {"domain":"electrical","component":"power","failure":"no_power","note":"Intermediate: driven by battery dies or battery not connected."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Code issues occur if there is an error in the code or the wrong program was uploaded.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"code_issues"}

name: Error in the Code
description: Bug or logic mistake in the Arduino code (wrong calibration, wrong units, timing bug, overflow) produces incorrect readings.
metadata: {"domain":"software","component":"arduino_firmware","failure":"bug","detection_hint":"Unit tests/sanity checks; compare with known reference; review recent code changes."}

name: Wrong program
description: Incorrect firmware/program is uploaded or running (wrong sketch/config), causing sensor logic to be incompatible with the setup.
metadata: {"domain":"software","component":"arduino_firmware","failure":"wrong_firmware","detection_hint":"Verify build/version; confirm configuration and pin mapping; reflashing resolves issue."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: No Power occurs if the battery dies or if the battery is not connected.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"no_power"}

name: Battery dies
description: Battery is depleted and can no longer provide sufficient voltage/current to power the Arduino/sensors.
metadata: {"domain":"electrical","component":"battery","failure":"depleted","detection_hint":"Low voltage reading; power LED off; device resets/browns out."}

name: Battery not connected
description: Battery is disconnected (loose connector, wrong wiring, unplugged), resulting in no power delivered to the Arduino/sensors.
metadata: {"domain":"electrical","component":"battery","failure":"disconnected","detection_hint":"Immediate no-power state; verify connector seating and wiring."}

name: Ultimate Fail
description: Top event: the system reaches an unacceptable operating state due to temperature or flow being outside normal conditions.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","type":"top_event","note":"Root of the failure tree (FTA top event)."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Ultimate Fail occurs if either Temperature Out of Normal Conditions or Flow out of normal conditions occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"ultimate_fail"}

name: Temperature Out of Normal Conditions
description: Temperature deviates from the normal operating range (too high or too low), indicating abnormal thermal control or cooling/heating issues.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","signal":"temperature","threshold":"outside_normal","note":"Intermediate: expands into above-normal and under-normal branches."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Temperature Out of Normal Conditions occurs if Temperature Above Normal Conditions or Temperature Under Normal Conditions occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"temp_out_of_normal_conditions"}

name: Flow out of normal conditions
description: Measured flow deviates from the normal operating range (too high or too low), indicating abnormal pump operation, restriction, leakage, or sensor issues.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","signal":"flow","threshold":"outside_normal","note":"Intermediate: expands into high-flow and low-flow branches."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Flow out of normal conditions occurs if High Flow or Low Flow occurs.
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"flow_out_of_normal_conditions"}

name: Low Flow
description: Flow rate drops below the defined normal operating range; commonly caused by blockages, leaks, pump issues, or sensor malfunction.
metadata: {"domain":"fluid_loop","signal":"flow","threshold":"below_normal","note":"Intermediate: expands into blockage/leak/pump/sensor branches."}

name: OR Gate
description: OR logic: Low Flow occurs if any one of its child causes occurs (blockages, leaks, pump issues, or sensor malfunction).
metadata: {"gate":"OR","parent":"low_flow"}
